release a film: The famous director will release a film in theaters next month, and fans are already lining up for tickets.
這位知名導演下個月將在戲院上映一部電影，影迷已經在排隊買票了。
release a statement: After the scandal, the company decided to release a statement apologizing to all of its customers.
醜聞爆發後，公司決定發表聲明，向所有顧客道歉。
release a prisoner: The government agreed to release a prisoner after new evidence proved that he was innocent.
在新證據證明他無罪後，政府同意釋放這名囚犯。
release tension: Going for a long run after school helps me release tension that builds up during a stressful day.
放學後去長跑能幫我釋放一整天累積的壓力。
release information: The police refused to release information about the suspect until the investigation was finished.
警方拒絕公布嫌犯的資訊，直到調查結束為止。
release energy: When we burn wood, chemical reactions release energy in the form of heat and light.
當我們燃燒木頭時，化學反應會以熱和光的形式釋放能量。
release one's grip: When the firefighter finally reached him, the boy was told to release his grip on the branch and let go.
當消防員終於到達他身邊時，男孩被告知要鬆手放開樹枝。
relieve pain: The doctor gave me some medicine to relieve pain in my back after I hurt it playing basketball.
我打籃球傷到背後，醫生給了我一些藥來減輕疼痛。
relieve stress: Listening to soft music before bed helps many students relieve stress during exam week.
睡前聽輕音樂能幫助許多學生在考試週紓解壓力。
relieve someone of duties: The company decided to relieve the manager of duties after he was caught stealing money.
經理被抓到偷錢後，公司決定解除他的職務。
relieve the pressure: Hiring two more nurses helped relieve the pressure on the busy hospital staff during flu season.
多聘請兩名護理師，幫忙減輕了流感季節忙碌醫院員工的壓力。
relieve boredom: On the long train ride to Taitung, we played card games to relieve boredom.
在前往台東的漫長火車旅程中，我們玩紙牌遊戲來解悶。
relieve a guard: At midnight, another soldier came to relieve a guard who had been standing at the gate for eight hours.
午夜時，另一名士兵前來和已在門口站了八小時的衛兵換班。
feel relieved: I really feel relieved now that the doctor says my grandmother's surgery went well.
既然醫生說奶奶的手術很順利，我真的鬆了一口氣。
rely on technology: Many young people rely on technology so much that they cannot read a paper map anymore.
許多年輕人太依賴科技，以至於再也看不懂紙本地圖。
rely on someone for: Young children rely on their parents for food, clothes, and love, so parents must be responsible.
幼童依靠父母提供食物、衣服和愛，所以父母必須負起責任。
rely heavily on: Taiwan has very few natural resources, so many factories rely heavily on imported oil and gas.
台灣天然資源很少，所以許多工廠高度依賴進口石油和天然氣。
can be relied upon: Amy is a great team leader who can be relied upon to finish every task on time.
Amy 是位很棒的組長，可以信賴她準時完成每項任務。
remain silent: When the teacher asked who broke the window, all the students chose to remain silent and looked at the floor.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，全班學生都選擇保持沉默，盯著地板看。
remain calm: During an earthquake, you should remain calm and hide under a strong table until the shaking stops.
地震時，你應該保持冷靜，躲在堅固的桌子下直到搖晃停止。
remain in office: The mayor will remain in office until the next election, even though many people want him to quit.
儘管很多人希望他辭職，市長仍將留任到下次選舉。
remain a mystery: How ancient people built these huge stone walls will probably remain a mystery to scientists forever.
古人如何建造這些巨大的石牆，對科學家來說可能永遠仍是個謎。
remain to be seen: Whether the new rule will really reduce traffic accidents in our city will remain to be seen for a while.
新規定是否真的能減少我們城市的交通事故，還有待觀察一段時間。
remain loyal: Even when the team loses every game, its true fans remain loyal and come to every match.
即使球隊每場都輸，真正的球迷仍保持忠誠，每場比賽都到場。
remark on the weather: When strangers meet in an elevator, they often remark on the weather to avoid an awkward silence.
陌生人在電梯裡相遇時，常會評論天氣來避免尷尬的沉默。
remark that: Teachers often remark that students today speak English more confidently than students did twenty years ago.
老師們常評論道，現在的學生說英文比二十年前的學生更有自信。
make a remark: He made a rude remark about her new haircut, and she refused to talk to him for days.
他對她的新髮型發表了無禮的意見，她好幾天都不理他。
a passing remark: It was just a passing remark, but her kind words about my drawing made me want to become an artist.
那只是隨口一提，但她對我畫作的好評讓我想成為藝術家。
